# KisanDirect

KisanDirect is an agriculture-focused marketplace connecting farmers and buyers.

## Public sections
- Marketplace: /
- Mandi: /mandi
- Recipes: /recipes
- KisanDirect AI: /kisandirect-ai
- About: /about

## Product and account areas
Authentication is required for cart, profile, orders, addresses, farmer tools and administration.

## Brand
The current product name is KisanDirect. Older references to KrishiConnect should not be used as the public brand name.
